app.name: Lockbox
app.description: Private cloud storage. No registration. One unique access code only.
app.heroHint: Tap to get your unique access code and start uploading materials

keyDialog.title: Save your code
keyDialog.description: This is the only way to access your data. The code is shown only once and cannot be recovered. Write it on paper or share it with someone you trust.
keyDialog.confirmSaved: I saved the code in a safe place
keyDialog.confirmSavedSplit: I saved both parts in different places
keyDialog.splitToggle: Split into 2 parts for two people
keyDialog.splitHint: Each part is useless without the other. Both are required to sign in.
keyDialog.clipboardWarning: Other apps on this phone can read the clipboard. Prefer writing the code on paper. Copied text is cleared after 30 seconds.
keyDialog.clipboardCopiedWarning: Code is on the clipboard. Other apps may see it. It will be cleared in 30 seconds.

accessDialog.title: Enter access code
accessDialog.description: Enter the code you received when creating the vault
accessDialog.sharesDescription: Enter both parts — they are combined into the code on this device only.
accessDialog.invalid: Invalid code. Please check and try again.
accessDialog.shareMismatch: The parts do not match or are damaged.
accessDialog.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
accessDialog.useShares: I have two parts of the code

vault.title: Your vault
vault.subtitle: Data is uploaded to the cloud immediately
vault.subtitleReadOnly: This code allows viewing and downloading only
vault.subtitleUploadOnly: This code allows uploading materials only
vault.uploadFormats: Photos, video, audio, PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT · photos & videos >10 MB compressed automatically
vault.textPlaceholder: Write a note. It is saved to the cloud immediately.

accessKeys.title: Codes for trusted people
accessKeys.createDescription: The code grants limited access and is shown only once. Share it with someone you trust.
accessKeys.presetLawyerHint: View and download materials — no upload or vault settings
accessKeys.presetUploadHint: Can add files, but cannot see what is already saved
accessKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this code? Anyone using it will lose access immediately.
accessKeys.revealDescription: Share the code with a trusted person. It is shown only once.

media.allowHint: Tap "Allow access" — your browser will show a system prompt.
media.deniedHint: Browser did not show a prompt — access is blocked. Enable it manually:
media.noPromptTitle: Why is there no system prompt?
media.noPromptBody: Browser blocks camera and microphone on this address. Open localhost.

install.bannerDescription: Add to home screen for quick access and recording
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari

toast.createRateLimited: Too many vaults created from this address. Try again tomorrow.
toast.queuedOffline: No network — file saved on this device for 1 hour

panic.aria: Erase this session and open a weather website

seo.title: Lockbox — secure cloud storage
seo.description: Private cloud storage without registration. One unique code — full access. Files, audio, video and text.
seo.keywords: secure storage, private vault, cloud storage, privacy, no registration
